Instrument (EN): Primary Affect Inventory — validated German-language 58-item state-affect form
Scales / measured domains (EN): SEEKING; CARE; PLAY; LUST; FEAR; ANGER; PANIC/GRIEF (seven state affect domains over last seven days)
Research provenance: Latifi et al., Journal of Personality Assessment, online 2026, DOI 10.1080/00223891.2026.2669304. The original 147-item German pilot was reduced to a 58-item seven-domain final form; two German-language adult convenience samples N=432 (EGA/reliability) and N=460 (CFA/invariance), omega >=.88 per domain.

Other translations: DE respondent wording psychometrically studied among German-speaking people; one source form, not independent DE/AT/CH local norms; English supplement is unvalidated translation.

Instrument (EN): Revised Turkish Francis Psychological Type Scales — 40 forced-choice item-pairs, retest study
Scales / measured domains (EN): Extraversion versus Introversion; Sensing versus Intuition; Thinking versus Feeling; Judging versus Perceiving (four paired-choice dimensions, 10 pairs each; type configurations are derived, not independent dimensions).
Research provenance: Tekke, Francis, McKenna & Village, Journal of Beliefs & Values, published online 2026-04-22; DOI 10.1080/13617672.2026.2651763. N=110 Turkish university students completed measures twice in a 10-week spiritual-counselling course; recovered four-factor structure but one item cross-loaded; lower reliability for perceiving function.
DB locales: No Francis/RTFPTS definition_key in published Holistic House app.assessment_versions on 2026-10-24; no product release.
EN form: Original Francis Psychological Type Scales studied elsewhere in English; this 2026 study DOES NOT provide new EN psychometric validation or proof of equivalent English/Turkish norms.
RU form: No independently validated RU respondent form documented in this study.
ES form: No independently validated ES respondent form documented in this study.
Other translations: TR-TR revised Turkish forced-choice form tested for factor structure, internal consistency and retest stability; a further study of an EXISTING adaptation, not a new original translation or country-invariant form.
Target population: 110 university students in Türkiye (94 women, 16 men; most approximately 20 years old), pre/post within 10-week psychology/spiritual-counselling curriculum; not validated here for clinical populations or general adults.
Commercial digital use / permission revi: Repository accepted/published text available under CC BY-NC-ND; a noncommercial no-derivatives manuscript license is NOT a commercial SaaS questionnaire-hosting right. Instrument (EN): Decision Hesitation Scale — sources of lung-cancer clinical-trial enrollment hesitation
Scales / measured domains (EN): Perceived trial risk (4); Perceived trial value (4); Patient–physician trust (5); Family influence (3); Resource barriers (3); Self-efficacy (4). Six source domains; not six psychiatric diagnoses.
Research provenance: Huang, Li & Zhang, Asia-Pacific Journal of Oncology Nursing, published online 2026-05-29, DOI 10.1016/j.apjon.2026.100985. China tertiary oncology N407 adults, EFA n203/CFA n204. Original pool 35 then pilot 33, FINAL Chinese form 23; alpha .929, ICC .779, CFI .934, RMSEA .072. Predictive utility not established.
